title: Koala wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='17' fill='#c4b5b0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='33' ry='30' fill='#b8a9a5'/>

  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='12' fill='#d4c6c2'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#e8d8d4'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='72' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#b8a9a5' transform='rotate(20 15 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='72' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#b8a9a5' transform='rotate(-20 85 72)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#b8a9a5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#d4c6c2'/>

  <path d='M44 60 Q50 65 56 60' fill='none' stroke='#7a6a75' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
